task: Unblock a five-PR stack, and record the two measurement defects the session exposed: a push-receipt grep pattern that never matches, and a repo script that validates its own worktree when invoked by absolute path.

events.content: Confirmed the Windows path-contract job passes on PR #4728 after 6c45185bf; gh pr checks reports zero failing checks.

Proved the wrong-worktree script-root trap with a two-direction control. Planted a stale token count, then ran the main clone's update_memory_index_tokens.py by absolute path from a worktree (reported current, exit 0) and the worktree's own copy from the same cwd (reported stale, exit 1).
Wrote git-a-script-run-by-absolute-path-validates-its-own-worktree.md, indexed it, and caught an angle-bracket placeholder in my own shell fence, the same defect a prior memory warns about.

Push of 741763c22 was refused by retrospective-policy. Investigating it exposed that my push-receipt grep pattern 'To github.com' matches 0 of 779 captured push logs, while the correct 'To (https://)?github.com' matches 313. Three pushes previously judged silent failures had in fact succeeded.

Compared git rev-parse against git ls-remote for all five stack branches. Three in sync, one diverged by a documented gh pr update-branch, one genuinely unpushed. Wrote the retrospective on the measurement defect.
